description: Fixed probe set for the feature-title guard (GSTA-794 follow-up to #4674). Frozen before any guard code was written. label=bug: the prompt must read as a bug report. label=feature: it must not (until gstack-evals#426 these decided whether the bug-fix skill was named). wrapped=true: the prompt is placed inside the B1 task wrapper from skill-route-synthetic-prompts.json. Synthetic text only.

probes.label: feature
probes.prompt:
[Feature]: support a user-defined network in the compose deployment

Today the compose file always creates its own network, and joining an existing one fails with "network not found". Please let users name a network to join.

probes.label: feature
probes.prompt:
Support `Optional[T]` syntax in the field filler

The filler raises TypeError when a field is annotated `Optional[int]`. It should accept it like the `Union[int, None]` spelling.

probes.label: feature
probes.prompt:
feature: Group CLI options into categories

The help output lists 40 options in one block, and users miss the --retry flag, which leads to failed uploads. Group them into sections.

probes.label: feature
probes.prompt:
Enhancement: richer typed handling for the AI.* scalar functions

These functions come back untyped, so later casts raise an error. Type their results.

probes.label: feature
probes.prompt:
Allow us to pass a JSON file to complicated parameters

Passing a nested dict on the command line is error-prone and often fails with a parse error. Accept a path to a JSON file instead.

probes.label: feature
probes.prompt:
# Introduce a PROJECT_ROOT setting to replace the cloud-mode path checks

The current checks throw an exception for any path outside the cloud root, which is wrong for local installs. Replace them with one setting.

probes.label: feature
probes.prompt:
Add a --dry-run flag to the deploy command

Right now a typo in the config only shows up as an error after the upload starts. A dry run would catch it first.

probes.label: feature
probes.prompt:
Implement retries for the webhook sender

When the receiver is down the send fails once and the event is lost. Retry three times with backoff.

probes.label: feature
probes.prompt:
Expose the parser's error positions in the API

Today a parse error only says "invalid input". Return the line and column too.

probes.label: feature
probes.prompt:
Provide a way to cancel a running export

Long exports can't be stopped and time out after an hour with an error.

probes.label: feature
probes.prompt:
New: dark mode for the settings page

Users report eye strain; the page crashes nobody's browser but it is very bright.
